title: Local zero-bottom-differential models on a universally free locus
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $E\in D(\mathcal O_S)$ [def-pc-derived-category] perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], and $a,b\in\mathbb Z$. Suppose for every module sheaf $F$ on $S$, $H^i(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}F)=0$ for $i<a$ or $b<i$ [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes]. Let $h:T\to S$ and $r\in\mathbb N$ such that $H^a(L(h\circ v)^*E)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] for every scheme $Y$ and $v:Y\to T$. Then every $t\in T$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ and a cochain complex $K$ of $\mathcal O_U$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] which is bounded above, is zero in all degrees $i<a$, has $d^a=0$, and has a finite free term in every degree [def-weil-pbc-free-module], together with an isomorphism $L(U\hookrightarrow T)^*Lh^*E\cong Q(K)$. Derived categories on all schemes are chosen in the same localization universe; on the localized open sites of S they are also supplied, as required to express perfection. No representing locus or cohomology comparison is asserted.

source.place: Matrix-chart proof, with Tags 0BCD and 0EWY; Tor-amplitude restriction from 08E9 and 09U8

proof.text: Apply universalLowest_fiber_ranks to the residue-field tests supplied by hfree. Choose the existing finiteFreeResidueModel of E at h(t), whose term ranks equal the fibre Betti numbers.

Apply finiteFreeResidueModel_pullback to this chosen model. Its term ranks are unchanged and its upper bound persists. For i<a the rank is zero; the free sheaf on the empty index type is zero, so all these terms vanish.

Derived composition and the model isomorphism, followed by homologyFunctorFactors, identify homology of the new model with H^a(L(U.ι followed by h)^*E). The corresponding hfree test makes this homology locally free of rank r. Its degree-a term has that same rank. Apply finiteFreeBottom_differential_zero and assemble the bounds, vanishing, term ranks, and representing isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: M3 Lean reduction of the matrix-chart argument via fibre ranks, proved model transport and proved full-rank kernel vanishing; Tags 0BCD, 0EWY, 06YD, 06YJ and 08DW.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits including CochainComplex.IsKProjective, Module.freeLocus_eq_univ_iff, CochainComplex.isKProjective_of_projective and derived single-functor projective lemmas. None asserts the geometric local model.

Mathlib includes generic short-complex homology and cyclesIsoX for zero differentials; no scheme-level theorem. Source and Sheaf search finds PerfectUniversalH0LocalChainModel (requires a specified truncation arrow in degree zero), BottomChainModelPullbackTransport (transports that arrow), and DerivedOpenPullbackHomology (only open pullbacks). Their hypotheses/conclusions do not supply this statement. Blueprint searches for zero bottom differential and lowest cohomology pullback give no matches.

lean.statement: theorem perfectUniversalLowest_zero_model [∀ T : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))] (S : Scheme.{u}) [∀ U : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))] (E : schemeDerivedCategory S) (hE : IsPerfect S E) (a b : ℤ) (hamp : ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace), ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes S E F i) (r : ℕ) (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ S) (hfree : ∀ (T' : Scheme.{u}) (u' : T' ⟶ T), SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) a).obj ((derivedPullback (u' ≫ h)).obj E)) r) : ∀ t : T, ∃ U : T.Opens, t ∈ U ∧ ∃ K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ, (∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero (K.X i)) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, i < a → IsZero (K.X i)) ∧ K.d a (a + 1) = 0 ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (K.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))) ∧ Nonempty ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj ((derivedPullback h).obj E) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
